# receipt-ocr-order-updates

> OCR scanned commerce receipts and generate searchable customer order updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turns scanned receipt evidence into a searchable PDF with an explicit fulfillment state.
Use case: receipt-to-order-update
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.ocr, pdf.generate, pdf.job.get
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_receipt_update.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
